summary: All 12 labels print wild jujube fruit extract at 1000 mg and no claim text. The stored trial (33385511) used Z. spinosa seed granules in 12 people with insomnia, a part the labels don't print. The nearest fit is a Z. jujuba hydroalcoholic extract at 15 g/day in 196 infertile women with PCOS (41618368): pregnancy, the primary outcome, showed no significant difference; lipids and glucose improved as secondary results. Food-amount trials of 30 g/day fruit (42577773, 38648942, 40964206) are not the 1000 mg extract and two of them missed glucose. 19142004 reports constipation benefit with no amount or named primary outcome.
